_meta.description: Drop model for a freshly farmed S-rank drive disc: how many substats it starts with, how its substats are drawn, and how likely each main stat is per slot. Read by the disc upgrade advisor (DOCS/disc_advice_plan.md).
_meta.mechanics: Confirmed (frzyc libs/zzz/consts disc.ts discSubstatRollData.S = {low 3, high 4, numUpgrades 5}): an S-rank disc starts with 3 or 4 substats and gets 5 upgrades; a 3-substat disc spends its first upgrade revealing the 4th substat, every other upgrade adds one roll to one of the 4 substats picked uniformly at random. Substats are drawn by weight without replacement and never duplicate the main stat.
_meta.provenance: No approved ZZZ source publishes drop weights, so the weights are PROVISIONAL and borrowed from Genshin Impact artifacts (frzyc genshin-optimizer libs/gi/upopt/src/consts.ts, citing the Genshin wiki page Artifact/Distribution), mapped to the closest ZZZ stat: Elemental Mastery -> Anomaly Proficiency / Anomaly Mastery / PEN Ratio, Energy Recharge -> flat PEN (substats) and Energy Regen (slot 6). Slot 4 = Circlet without Healing, slot 5 = Goblet (6 elements), slot 6 = Sands with Impact at the special-stat weight. initial_substats comes from a 711-disc sample of Lv. 15 S-rank discs (533 with 8 total rolls, 178 with 9). sets_per_source: guides report each Area Patrol stage drops 2 sets (verify on the stage card).
_meta.conventions: Weights are relative (any positive scale); only their ratios matter. Slots 1-3 have a single main stat and are omitted. The slot-5 'Attribute DMG%' entry is an object of element -> weight, one weight per element variant of the disc.
